name: A Burlington street

place_source.title: Wikidata: Burlington, Vermont (Q31058), coordinate location and elevation above sea level

blurb: A Burlington, Vermont street scene with maples, white pines and birch along the sidewalk, a lawn and a city park: chickadees, jays and a gray squirrel by day, and opossums and a big brown bat after dark.

facts.text: Burlington, Vermont has a humid continental climate (Köppen Dfa) with cold, snowy winters and warm, humid summers.

source.title: Wikipedia: Burlington, Vermont

facts.text: Lake Champlain, one of the largest freshwater lakes in the United States, lies between Vermont and New York adjacent to Burlington.

source.title: Wikipedia: Lake Champlain
source.attribution: Wikipedia contributors, "Lake Champlain", English Wikipedia, CC BY-SA 4.0

facts.text: Burlington is Vermont's most populous city, on the eastern shore of Lake Champlain.

source.title: Wikipedia: Burlington, Vermont
source.attribution: Wikipedia contributors, "Burlington, Vermont", English Wikipedia, CC BY-SA 4.0

facts.text: The nominal average January temperature in Burlington is about 21°F, and the nominal average July temperature is about 71°F.
